post_slowdown_asr_text: At midnight, for seven nights, I slowly opened his door. You should have seen my patience. He never even moved. Then I let one thin ray escape from my lantern. But I always found that eye shut. I could not act. I hated his eye, not him. Every morning, I kindly asked about his night's sleep. On night eight, I almost laughed at my own cleverness. Then my thumb slipped on the catch of my lantern.
